initiatives.name: Product Pipeline & Launch Expansion Strategy
initiatives.summary: Hikma has built a development pipeline of 118 approved/tentatively approved products across US, MENA and EU markets, targeting a combined addressable market size of over $45 billion. The pipeline spans simple injectables, differentiated RTU, complex products and biosimilars.

evidence.title: Pipeline targeting $45 billion addressable market

evidence.title: Expanded product launches planned through 2029
evidence.summary: Hikma has a structured mid-term launch plan with 79 expected launches in 2026, scaling to 49 launches by 2029 across multiple platforms and geographies. The plan covers oral solids, injectables, respiratory and other dosage forms across US, MENA and EU markets.
